items.title: 13.8 Aabi silver ion aur phir aabi ammonia ke saath halides ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.8 heading, printed page 297.

blocks.text: Halide ions do qadmon se pehchane jate hain: aabi silver nitrate se precipitation (13.8.1), phir aabi ammonia mein silver halide ki solubility ka test (13.8.2). Yeh silsila halide ions ko alag pehchanne ka ba-zabta tareeqa deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aabi potassium bromide ko potassium iodide se alag pehchanne ka saada kimiyai test reagents aur mushahidat ke saath bayan karein (exercise Q.2j).
blocks.explanation: Har ek mein aabi silver nitrate dalein: bromide silver bromide ka cream precipitate deta hai, iodide silver iodide ka halka peela precipitate. Phir ghaliz ammonia dalein: cream AgBr be-rang solution mein hal ho jata hai, jabke peela AgI bina hale rehta hai.

items: Silver nitrate test: Ag+ AgCl (safed), AgBr (cream), AgI (peela) precipitate karta hai; ammonia phir unhen solubility se alag pehchanti hai.
